NAkx4j29LEc.description:
Ontologies in PLM: Enhancing Enterprise Search Capabilities

Arquimedes Canedo | Distinguished Engineer, Siemens Digital Industries Software
https://www.linkedin.com/in/arquimedes-canedo-61962210/

Description
Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) is a cornerstone of modern engineering, enabling the design, development, and manufacturing of complex products such as cars and airplanes. However, PLM systems grapple with vast and fragmented data. Components like brakes in a car span multiple disciplines (mechanical, electrical, and software), each with unique data models and terminologies. This diversity creates significant challenges for PLM enterprise search, often yielding inconsistent and disconnected results.

This talk presents how ontologies can address these challenges by unifying PLM data models, guiding data extractors, and delivering a consistent search experience across disparate information. We will present how upper, domain-specific, and cross-domain ontologies harmonize data from engineering tools.

Through real-world examples, we will demonstrate the issues faced in PLM search and how ontology-driven solutions provide clarity and cohesion. Additionally, we will present an architecture for a knowledge graph (KG) in a search index, challenging the traditional view that KGs must rely on property graphs or triple stores. This approach enables efficient search using discovery rules and dynamic relationships tailored to evolving data.

Finally, we’ll discuss the organizational challenges of introducing ontologies and knowledge graphs into PLM systems, offering insights into the collaborative process, strategies for success, and lessons learned.

sYdN4b14rHU.title: Anthropic崛起史：最强AI背后的矛与盾，布道者与伪君子
sYdN4b14rHU.description:
五年时间，冲击万亿美元估值。Anthropic的增长，几乎可以用一条陡峭到难以置信的曲线来形容。在这场商业奇迹背后，是一个充满矛盾的故事：一家因担忧AI失控而诞生的公司，如今却成为了全球AI竞赛中最激进的参与者之一。

故事可以追溯到2014年的百度硅谷实验室。Dario Amodei在语音识别研究中，观察到后来影响大模型发展的Scaling Law规律。几年后，因AI安全、商业化路径与组织信任上的分歧，他与另外六位核心成员集体离开OpenAI，创立Anthropic。

这群曾经担忧AI发展过快的研究者，最终找到了一条独特的商业道路：将安全、可靠与信任转化为企业市场的优势，凭借Claude系列模型、Claude Code与企业业务的扩张，迅速跻身全球AI竞争的中心。

这期视频，我们采访了曾与Dario共事的研究者，以及投资人、科技媒体人和行业人士，还原这段从技术探索到商业爆发的历史。特殊的治理架构、巨额算力投入，以及与云巨头复杂的资本关系，也构成了Anthropic的另一面。

成功也并没有消解Anthropic诞生时的矛盾，它警告强大AI带来的风险，自己却不断加速。它试图建立安全边界，又必须面对监管、政府合作与商业利益的现实。随着规模和权力增长，最初的使命，究竟还能在多大程度上决定它的选择？

xJUWVxZfNVI.title: “后黄仁勋时代”：英伟达的护城河、资本棋局与AI产业变数
xJUWVxZfNVI.description:
掌舵33年后，黄仁勋突然辞去了英伟达CEO职务，并离开董事会。一场丑闻风波，让这家站在全球AI浪潮中心的科技巨头，猝然进入“后黄仁勋时代”。当创始人不再掌舵，英伟达究竟失去了什么？

这个问题，远不止一次管理层交接。AI Coding正在改变芯片软件的开发方式，CUDA的生态壁垒正在被冲击，GPU竞争正在走向整机柜、数据中心级别的系统整合。英伟达与台积电等供应链伙伴长期建立的信任与协作，能否脱离黄仁勋本人继续维系？这些都是决定英伟达未来竞争力的关键变量。

与此同时，黄仁勋还留下了一张横跨AI产业链的商业版图：押注开源模型与开发者生态，推动收购Hugging Face，投资AI实验室、云计算和数据中心，甚至通过资本支持创造对自身芯片的需求。继任者会延续这套激进的扩张战略，还是重新衡量其中的风险？

我们采访了多位来自硅谷和华尔街的芯片、科技及金融行业人士，从技术路线、供应链、资本布局，到销售体系、人才与管理制度，重新审视英伟达的内部运转逻辑。60多位高管直接汇报的扁平化组织，曾经是这家公司的效率秘诀，如今却也成为继任难题。

黄仁勋的远见、魄力和号召力塑造了今天的英伟达，而黄仁勋离开后的英伟达，要如何保持卓越？我们没有答案。

io7qhEjJoik.description:
Michael Tomasello is a developmental psychologist who spent twenty years at the Max Planck Institute in Germany putting children and great apes into the same experiments, and is now back at Duke University. His book The Evolution of Agency asks what it takes for a living thing, or a machine, to act for its own reasons.

SPONSOR:

---

His answer starts with unpredictability. Where the environment is predictable, nature builds the behaviour in; where it isn't, it builds a decision maker. Tim and Tomasello test that on a dumb traffic light, a thermostat and a robot vacuum, then follow the line to humans: reptiles running simple control loops, a squirrel that imagines itself falling and takes another branch, and great apes that go looking for more information before they commit.

The second half is about shared agency. Humans form joint goals, attend to the same things together, and learn that one object can be seen from different perspectives. Children who lose the sound on a video call invent gestures and turn them into conventions. Large language models, Tomasello argues, started at the endpoint and skipped that infrastructure. On the way: the stag hunt, why lying only works among cooperators, whether capital is an agent, why a Turing test isn't close to sufficient, and Dennett's intentional stance.
